summary: Comprehensive testing of the new CineVerse feature bundle (actors death fields, user-editable movies/series, upcoming releases, edit log, public user profile, avatar upload, moderation/suspension, roles, uploads). Backend 15/15 pytest tests PASS; Frontend flows verified via Playwright: home Upcoming section, nav Create dropdown, regular-user movie creation + redirect + Edit dialog + no Delete, actor page (born/died/places/age-at-death), public user profile, admin Users tab with suspend/role controls, suspend blocks login with red toast, suspended badge on public profile.

minor.issue: Storage path hardcoded to '{APP_NAME}/uploads/admin/{id}.{ext}' — endpoint is now for any auth user; folder name 'admin' is misleading. Also computed 'backend_url' variable is unused.
Response only returns {ok, suspended_until}; missing echoed reason. Also no self-suspension guard (a moderator could suspend themselves).

issues: Release date field uses browser-native <input type="date"> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component. Consider replacing for consistent dark-theme UX.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native date input in EntityEditDialog (Movie/Series/Actor forms) with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for consistent dark-theme styling.
(Optional) Rename hardcoded 'admin' folder segment in /api/upload storage path to 'user' or use requesting user's id.
(Optional) Prevent moderator from suspending themselves in POST /api/moderation/users/{id}/suspend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1092 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; split into routers (auth, movies, series, actors, moderation, uploads) for maintainability.
Enrichment functions (enrich_movie/enrich_series) issue N+1 aggregate queries for reviews per movie — for list endpoints this could be batched.
CORS allow_origins uses env FRONTEND_URL only; if the app is opened from a different preview host, requests would be rejected. Consider allowlist or wildcard-with-credentials handling.
get_current_user re-parses suspended_until on every request — acceptable but could cache decoded user for the request lifespan.
No brute-force / rate-limiting on /auth/login (spec calls out lockout after 5 fails).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@cineverse.com / Admin@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Fresh users registered per test run.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_/UITEST_ prefixed actors, movies, series, and throwaway users; ephemeral, not cleaned up (safe due to prefix isolation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Note pytest-xdist is enabled by /app/backend/pytest.ini (LoadScopeScheduling) — fixtures must generate unique emails per worker (already uses uuid). Suspension flow uses admin as moderator (admin passes get_current_moderator dep). Frontend: use native date input format YYYY-MM-DD when filling EntityEditDialog. Sign-in submit button click occasionally does not trigger form submit via CSS selector; use inputs[1].press('Enter') instead.
